title: Workspace
intro: The name, time zone, default language and country of this workspace.
name: Name
slugHint: Used in sign-in links. It cannot be changed.
timeZoneHint: Decides what "today" is and in which time times are typed, from the next action on. Recorded times keep their moment.
languageHint: For emails to people who have not chosen a language.
countryHint: Public holidays for people without a country of their own.
readOnly: Only an administrator can change these settings.
saved: Saved. The changes apply from now on.
